names.name: abs
names.summary: Return the absolute value of the argument.
names.plain: Gives how far a number is from 0, so always 0 or more.

names.name: all
names.summary: Return True if bool(x) is True for all values x in the iterable.
names.plain: Is True only if every item is true.

names.name: any
names.summary: Return True if bool(x) is True for any x in the iterable.
names.plain: Is True if at least one item is true.

names.name: ascii

names.name: bool

names.plain: Makes True or False from a value.

names.name: chr
names.summary: Return a Unicode string of one character with ordinal i; 0 <= i <= 0x10ffff.
names.plain: Gives the letter for a character number.

names.name: dict

names.name: dir

names.name: float

names.plain: Makes a decimal number from a number or from text.

names.name: format

names.plain: Makes a whole number from a number or from text.

names.name: isinstance
names.summary: Return whether an object is an instance of a class or of a subclass thereof.
names.plain: Checks if a value is of a kind, such as int or str.

names.name: iter

names.name: min
names.summary: With a single iterable argument, return its smallest item.
names.plain: Gives the smallest of the values.

names.name: pow

names.name: print

names.plain: Shows the values on the screen.

names.name: range
names.summary: Make a row of whole numbers, counting up (or down).
names.plain: Counts through whole numbers, from 0 up to but not including the number given.

names.name: repr

names.name: str
